Are you a reliable worker who is precise and enjoys taking responsibility? Are you the forklift operator ready to work in our busy, dynamic yet well-structured warehouse in Duiven, Gelderland? Then read on! 
Job description: 
As a forklift operator, you ensure pallets and packages are properly unloaded, weighed, and placed in the right location within our warehouse. You work three shifts with a weekly rotation: 14:30 till 23:00 PM, 17:30 till 01:00 AM and 23:00 till 07:00 AM. Besides unloading trucks, you are responsible for internal movements within the warehouse. When packages or pallets have been correctly scanned or checked by your colleagues, you expertly maneuver goods to the right truck. Because you take ownership of your work, you remain alert for errors or when adjustments are needed to package routes or truck loading. Besides having an excellent job as a forklift operator, there are plenty of growth opportunities, for example, to become a reach truck operator or team leader. Despite our size, we value personal attention and believe the most important thing is that you feel at home in a friendly team.Are you the reliable, enthusiastic, and organized forklift operator we are looking for? Apply now! What we offer: - A salary of €3,028 to €3,587 gross per month, including shift allowances and end-of-year bonus , based on a full-time employment - 8% holiday allowance and extra vacation days increasing with age - Travel allowance of € 0.23 per kilometer - Plenty of growth opportunities within our warehouse - National holidays off and paid - Weekends off! What we ask: - You are at least 18 years old due to working with various machines - You have a forklift certificate (or are willing to obtain it through us) - You speak Dutch or English - You are willing to follow an (online) Awareness Dangerous Goods course after a successful tour. Are you technically minded, precise, and motivated by building complex technical products? For ASML in Veldhoven, we are looking for multiple Assemblers who want to work on some of the most advanced technology in the world. As an Assembler, you will be responsible for accurately assembling, testing, and manufacturing complex modules and components. You will work according to technical drawings, work instructions, and established quality standards, with quality and precision always being your top priorities. You will work in a clean, high-tech production environment where precision, teamwork, and continuous improvement are key. It is an environment where your technical skills directly contribute to the quality and reliability of the products. Wie zoeken we? You are someone who works carefully and with a high level of concentration and enjoys assembling technical products. You have a strong eye for detail and understand that even the smallest deviation can be important when working with complex high-tech products. You are also a true team player. You communicate clearly, are open to feedback, and are willing to support your colleagues when needed. You take ownership of your work and do not hesitate to act when you identify a problem. You are eager to learn and motivated to further develop your technical skills within a high-tech environment. Because you may work with different products and activities, you are flexible and able to switch easily between tasks. What you bring MBO Level 3 or 4, preferably in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical field. Experience in a technical production or assembly environment. Experience assembling and testing electronic and/or mechatronic components. Experience working with hand tools such as torque wrenches, pliers, and precision tools. Ability to work with technical drawings and work instructions. Basic knowledge of electrical principles, such as resistance, induction, and

high-voltage testing, is an advantage. Good command of the English language, both written and spoken. Conversational command of the Dutch language is an advantage. Experience working in a cleanroom or contamination-controlled environment is an advantage. Excellent fine motor skills and the ability to work with a high level of precision. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will have the opportunity to work in one of the most innovative high-tech manufacturing environments in the world. You will receive an extensive onboarding program and the necessary training and guidance to become familiar with the work, products, and processes. In addition, we offer: A full-time position of 40 hours per week. A temporary assignment of 12 months. A day shift position. A gross monthly salary of up to €3,400, excluding bonus and holiday allowance. 27 days of paid annual leave. 13 ADV (working time reduction) days. A 13th-month salary, paid annually. An annual bonus based on the company's results. Extensive onboarding, training, and opportunities for further development. The opportunity to work in an international and highly innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines are used to produce the chips that form the foundation of virtually all modern technology. From smartphones and computers to cars and medical equipment, ASML's technology plays an important role in our everyday lives. As an Assembler, you are part of that impact. With your precision and craftsmanship, you ensure that complex modules are assembled and tested according to the highest quality standards. Every module you assemble contributes to the technology that enables the future of the semiconductor industry. Your work. Your craftsmanship. Your contribution to the technology of tomorrow. Do you have a technical mindset and a keen eye for detail? Do you enjoy hands-on work and building innovative machines that are used worldwide? This is your opportunity! At Tennant in Uden, we are looking for an Assembly Technician who is eager to contribute to the production of smart, sustainable cleaning machines. Wie zoeken we? You’re someone who enjoys practical, hands-on technical work and takes pride in doing things right. In addition, you bring: MBO-level education or equivalent technical experience Experience in a assembly environment Knowledge of mechanical engineering, hydraulics, electrical systems, or combustion engines is an advantage The ability to read, write, and speak Dutch or English so you can understand work instructions Wat bieden wij je? A starting salary between €3.334,00 and €3.473,00 gross per month, depending on your experience and qualifications An ADV allowance of 5.38% on top of your hourly wage Travel allowance of up to €9 per day Employment under the Metalektro collective labor agreement (CAO) A pleasant and informal working atmosphere in a stable international company A full-time position in day shift (07:00–16:00) Opportunities for growth and the prospect of a permanent contract upon good performance Functieomschrijving As an Assembly Technician, you play a key role in building high-quality, innovative machines. You work from 07:00 to 16:00 in a structured and hands-on environment, where no two days are the same. Your daily responsibilities include reading and interpreting technical drawings and work instructions, and consulting with colleagues whenever needed. You prepare materials and components for assembly and assemble parts using hand tools and measuring equipment. This includes working with electrical and hydraulic connections, adhesive bonding, and tightening components according to torque specifications. You also ensure that tools, machines, and equipment are well maintained. In addition, you accurately register completed

tasks and materials in the system, test components using measuring instruments, and actively contribute ideas to improve processes on the production floor. In short, this is a varied and practical technical role where your precision and craftsmanship truly make an impact. Tennant is a leading global manufacturer of industrial cleaning machines used in airports, shopping centers, and factories worldwide. At the modern production site in Uden, around 200 colleagues work together every day to build, improve, and ship these high-quality machines. The working environment is informal and friendly, while offering the stability and growth opportunities of a large international organization.
